    ("gammainc(nan, -1.0)", lambda: special.gammainc(np.nan, -1.0)),
    ("gammainc(nan, -0.0)", lambda: special.gammainc(np.nan, -0.0)),
    ("gammainc(nan, 0.0)", lambda: special.gammainc(np.nan, 0.0)),
    ("gammainc(nan, inf)", lambda: special.gammainc(np.nan, np.inf)),
    ("gammainc(nan, nan)", lambda: special.gammainc(np.nan, np.nan)),
    ("gammainc(-inf, nan)", lambda: special.gammainc(-np.inf, np.nan)),
    ("gammainc(-1.0, nan)", lambda: special.gammainc(-1.0, np.nan)),
    ("gammainc(-0.0, nan)", lambda: special.gammainc(-0.0, np.nan)),
    ("gammainc(0.0, nan)", lambda: special.gammainc(0.0, np.nan)),
    ("gammainc(inf, nan)", lambda: special.gammainc(np.inf, np.nan)),
    ("gammaincc(nan, -inf)", lambda: special.gammaincc(np.nan, -np.inf)),
    ("gammaincc(nan, 0.0)", lambda: special.gammaincc(np.nan, 0.0)),
    ("gammaincc(0.0, nan)", lambda: special.gammaincc(0.0, np.nan)),
    ("chdtr(nan, 0.0)", lambda: special.chdtr(np.nan, 0.0)),
    ("chdtrc(nan, 0.0)", lambda: special.chdtrc(np.nan, 0.0)),
]

        probe(name, result)
